title: Jujutsu: A Git-Compatible VCS - Git Merge 2022
summary: Martin von Zweigbergk presents Jujutsu (jj), a Git-compatible VCS with undo, anonymous branches, first-class conflicts, automatic rebasing, and the working copy as a commit. He also covers plans at Google.
why: HN links it as the canonical talk on Jujutsu's design, especially conflict handling.

quote.text: I think this was the talk
